clips.title: Weekend Walks with My Child
grammar: 〜ようにする — making an effort to

lines.ja: 週末はいつも子どもと、天気がよければいつも外に出かけるようにしてます。
lines.en: On weekends, whenever the weather is nice, I always make sure to go out with my child.
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.ja: 朝は教会に行って、お昼にはこうやって散歩してます。
lines.en: We go to church in the morning, and around noon we go on walks like this.
lines.speaker: Youn-a

clips.title: What Do You Want for Lunch?

lines.ja: 公園でたくさん遊んで、
lines.en: After playing a lot at the park,
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.ja: 今日は週末なので、ランチを外で食べようと思います。
lines.en: since it's the weekend today, I think we'll eat lunch out.
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.en: What do you want to eat?
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.en: You don't want to eat anything?
lines.speaker: Youn-a

clips.title: Time to Go Home for a Nap

lines.ja: もう帰って昼寝させないと。
lines.en: We need to go home and let him take a nap.
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.ja: 昼寝させてご飯作って食べさせます。
lines.en: I'll have him nap, make a meal, and feed him.
lines.speaker: Youn-a

lines.ja: 楽しかった？あ、嬉しい。また遊びに行こうね。
lines.en: It was fun? Ah, I'm glad. Let's go play again, okay?
lines.speaker: Youn-a
